There's a moment every morning — before the shop opens, before the first customer
walks in — when I pull a shot just for myself.

It's not about caffeine. It's about **attention**. Watching the crema form. Feeling
the warmth of the cup. Noticing whether today's pull is brighter or heavier than
yesterday's.

## The beans know

Coffee is seasonal. The same farm, the same varietal, will taste different in March
than it did in November. If you're paying attention, your morning cup is a little
calendar — marking time in flavor instead of dates.

## Make it yours

You don't need a $3,000 espresso machine. You need:

- Good beans, freshly roasted (within 2 weeks)
- A simple grinder (hand grinder is fine)
- Hot water and a few minutes of patience

The ritual is the point. The coffee is just the excuse.
